Passive; When making a Medicine check, must spend :g%::g%::g%: or :g$: to decrease the target’s strain and wound threshold by 2 each until the end of the current session.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Passive; When making a Computer (Hacking) check, :g%: may not be spent to alert other users to this character’s presence.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Incidental (Out of Turn); During social encounters, may spend :g%::g%::g%: generated by an opponent to discover (or invent) a legal violation that requires a fine, fee, or additional authorization form that the opponent must complete before accomplishing their goals.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Action; Once per encounter, as an action, make an opposed Knowledge versus Cool check targeting one character in the encounter; if successful, the target increases the difficulty of all social skill checks they make by two, to a maximum of Formidable, until the end of the encounter.
Source: Expanded Player's Guide

Maneuver; As a maneuver, may increase the strength of one active piece of ice by 1 until the end of the character’s next turn.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Incidental (Out of Turn); When providing skill assistance, may reroll up to two of the dice in the pool before resolving the check.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Action; Once per encounter, may make an Average Charm check targeting a group of bystanders or other neutral NPCs at medium range; if the check is successful, one of the bystanders (plus one per additional :g*:) becomes a Human First Extremist; these NPCs form a single minion group and join the ongoing encounter. These NPCs may have been regular people convinced by the rep or they may have been members of Human First all along.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Incidental; When making an opposed Negotiation or Streetwise check to purchase or sell an item, may suffer 2 strain to add :g*: to the results.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Passive; Add :gK::gK: to any opponent’s checks made on a system that this character has control of.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Action; Once per encounter, may make a Daunting Leadership check; if successful, until the end of the encounter, all allies in the encounter may perform an additional move maneuver on their turn without downgrading their action or suffering strain—but they still may only perform two maneuvers during their turn.
Source: Expanded Player's Guide

Passive; Adds :gB: to combat checks when there are at least two other friendly nemeses, rivals, or minion groups engaged in the encounter. Add :gK: to combat checks when there are no other friendly nemeses, rivals, or minion groups engaged in the encounter.
Source: Genesys Core Rulebook

Incidental; When making a Brawl check, may spend :g^::g^: or :g!: to apply a dose of contact poison to the target; the target must immediately make a Hard Resilience check as an incidental; if they fail, they suffer 5 wounds plus 1 wound per :g%:; :g!: means they must make the check again at the start of their next turn, as the poison remains in their system.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Passive; Halve the damage dealt to this character before applying soak, unless the weapon has the Blast or Burn quality (regardless of whether the quality is activated).
Source: Expanded Player's Guide

Incidental; This character may spend :g^: from a Brawl check to hit one additional engaged opponent that would be no more difficult to attack than the original target, dealing base damage +1 damage per :g*:.
Source: Genesys Core Rulebook

Action; May make a Hard Computers (Sysops) check targeting one opponent on the system to damage one of their active icebreakers one step, plus one additional step per :g^:.

Maneuver; May spend a maneuver to direct one friendly minion group within medium range; that group may immediately perform a free maneuver or add :gB: to its next check.

Incidental (Out of Turn); Once per encounter, may suffer 2 strain as an out-of-turn incidental during an ally’s turn; the ally loses a maneuver and either heals 6 strain or may reroll a fear check they just failed.
Source: Expanded Player's Guide

Action; As an action, may make an Average Athletics check targeting one engaged opponent; if successful, target is knocked prone, suffers 4 strain, and may not stand from prone during their next turn.

Passive; Can operate independently, or can be controlled directly by an operator via wireless link; if being controlled, this character counts as having ranks in a skill equal to the controller’s ranks in that skill.

Maneuver; Once per encounter as a maneuver, may make a Simple (-) Discipline check to heal 1 wound per :g*:.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Passive; At the start of the encounter, all of their opponents must make a fear check as an out-of-turn incidental, as per page 243 of the Genesys Core Rulebook. Source: Genesys Core Rulebook

Passive; Enemies who start their turn engaged with this character lose their free maneuver.

Incidental (Out of Turn); While in this character’s establishment, may spend :g%: from checks targeting this character to have the character making the check suffer 2 strain instead of 1.

Passive; When providing assistance on another character's Coercion checks, add :g*: to results for each minion in the group beyond the first.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Passive; If this character is caring for a character who is benefiting from natural rest, the resting character heals 2 wounds each night and decreases the difficulty of any Resilience checks they make to heal Critical Injuries by 1, to a minimum of Easy.

Action; With access to any sort of tools or parts, may make an Average Mechanics check. If successful, creates an item with rarity equal to the number of ✸.

Passive; When interacting with this character, characters may spend :g^: to recover 2 strain, and GMs may spend :g%: to inflict 2 strain.

Passive; When any character makes a check to recover strain while engaged with this character, they recover 2 additional strain.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Incidental; After making a combat check, this creature may spend :g!: to move the target up to short range, inflict 4 strain, and knock the target prone.
Source: Expanded Player's Guide

Passive; When searching a character or their possessions, that character suffers 2 strain.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Passive; When targeted by a social skill check that inflicts strain, reduce the strain suffered by 2 to a minimum of 1.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Incidental (Out of Turn); After suffering a Critical Injury, may spend one Story Point to reduce the Critical Injury result by 50; if this reduces the Critical Injury result to less than 01, the character does not suffer a Critical Injury.

Passive; When making any social skill or combat check targeting an opponent of the church, add :g*::g%: to the result.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Passive; When performing the burn system action, reduce difficulty of check by 2, and damage the system one additional step for every additional :g*: (instead of :g*::g*:).

Passive; When an opponent targets this character with a combat check, they suffer 4 strain.

Passive; Characters targeting this character with a social skill check suffer 3 strain.
Source: Expanded Player's Guide

Action; Once per session may spend an action to make a Hard Computer (Sysops) check; if successful all ice or icebreakers controlled by this character or one ally increase their strength by 2 for the remainder of the encounter.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

Incidental (Out of Turn); May spend :g^::g^::g^: or :g!: from a success combat check using their liquid-metal lasso to inflict one hit from the weapon on one other target within short range of the original target, inflicting base damage +1 per :g*:.

Passive; When making a Coercion check to maintain a favor after calling it in, the check is an Average Coercion check instead of an opposed check.
Source: Shadow of the Beanstalk

items.name: Guided Missile Launcher

items.special: Blast 10, Cumbersome 4, Guided 3, Limited Ammo 3, Prepare 1

items.name: Stun Grenade
items.special: Blast 8, Disorient 3, Limited Ammo 1, Stun damage

defense.name: Camouflaged
defense.ex: Rival or nemesis animals or non-humans

defense.name: Very Tough
defense.ex: Rival animals or non-humans and all nemeses

defense.name: Giant Body
defense.ex: Silhouette 3 or higher animal rivals and nemeses

items.name: Bone Lacing
items.description: Skeleton reinforced with buckyweave and lightweight alloys.
items.effect: Whenever you suffer a Critical Injury, you may roll twice on the Critical Injury Result table and choose which result to use.

items.name: Cybereyes
items.description: Prosthetic eyes with enhanced sight, often with night-vision or infrared.
items.effect: Remove setback dice caused by smoke or darkness on any checks. Can display information from your PAD on the cybereyes.

items.name: Cyberlimb Agility
items.description: High-tech prosthetic replacing an organic limb.
items.effect: Increases Brawn or Agility by 1 (your choice). Strain threshold -1 if you have one or more cybernetic arms, and a further -1 if you have one or more cybernetic legs.

items.name: Cyberlimb Brawn
items.description: High-tech prosthetic replacing an organic limb.
items.effect: Increases Brawn or Agility by 1 (your choice). Strain threshold -1 if you have one or more cybernetic arms, and a further -1 if you have one or more cybernetic legs.

items.name: Cybernetic Heart
items.description: Mechanical replacement heart (a Cyberorgan).
items.effect: Increases wound threshold by 2. Special exception to the +1 cybernetic limit; wound threshold cannot be increased by more than 2 with cybernetics.

items.name: Cybernetic Lungs
items.description: Mechanical replacement lungs (a Cyberorgan).
items.effect: Survive up to five minutes in an unbreathable atmosphere (not vacuum) without suffocating.

items.name: Cybernetic Liver
items.description: Mechanical replacement liver (a Cyberorgan).
items.effect: Immune to the effects of alcohol.

items.name: Enhanced Hearing
items.description: Cybernetics that improve hearing to superhuman levels.
items.effect: Remove setback dice caused by loud noises or sound-based attacks on any checks.

items.name: Enhanced Reflexes
items.description: Nanomachines and nerve therapy supercharge the nervous system.

items.name: Neuro-Regulator
items.description: Microelectronic circuits wired into the brain, increasing focus and suppressing fear.
items.effect: Increases Willpower by 1. You may lose the good sense to flee dangerous situations, and at the GM's discretion suffer a setback die on social skill checks for seeming robotic.

items.name: Pain Editor
items.description: Neural shunts that let you ignore the effects of pain.
items.effect: Once per encounter when you suffer a Critical Injury, activate as an out-of-turn incidental: until the end of the encounter, ignore any skill check penalties from that Critical Injury (GM may rule it doesn't apply to e.g. blindness or loss of a limb). At the end of the encounter you suffer the penalties again.

items.name: Skulljack
items.description: Surgically implanted access point (essentially a BMI) to connect to and control computers; wired or wireless.
items.effect: Provides all benefits of a BMI. In a Network encounter, 'go deep' as a maneuver: you can only interact with the Network until you 'go shallow' as a maneuver, but may perform a second maneuver each turn during Network encounters without spending strain. Wireless signals can sometimes be suppressed or intercepted.

items.name: Spinal Modem
items.description: Portable-computer-grade processor built into the spine and linked directly to the brain.
items.effect: Is a computer that can have up to two icebreakers and one piece of ice active during Network encounters; has wireless and wired ports. Provides all benefits of a BMI, including 'go deep' / 'go shallow' maneuvers and a free second maneuver each turn in Network encounters. You can never disconnect from the Network (can always be traced or targeted by hackers).

items.name: Sub-Dermal Armor
items.description: Thin buckyweave and ballistic gel plates implanted beneath the skin.
items.effect: Increases soak by 1.

items.name: Cat Claws
items.description: Sharp, retractable claws grow under the nails.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain to have unarmed Brawl attacks deal +1 damage and have Critical rating 3 until the end of the encounter. Unnoticeable without thorough medical inspection when retracted.

items.name: Chameleon Skin
items.description: Change skin color at will; initially only solid colors within normal human skin tones, with practice nearly any color and patterns.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain before a Stealth check or a check to apply or adopt a disguise to add a Success to the results.

items.name: Enhanced Healing
items.description: Supercharged natural healing.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain before a Resilience check to recover from Critical Injuries to add a Success to the results. When healing via natural rest, increase wounds healed by 1.

items.name: Enhanced Muscles: Coordination
items.description: Musculature enhanced for coordination and reflexes. Only one type of enhanced muscles allowed.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain before a Coordination or Ranged (Light) check to add a Success to the results.

items.name: Enhanced Muscles: Strength
items.description: Musculature enhanced for raw strength. Only one type of enhanced muscles allowed.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain before an Athletics, Brawl, or Melee check to add a Success to the results.

items.name: Enhanced Olfactory Receptors
items.description: Highly sensitive sense of smell that can be triggered at will.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain before a Survival check to add a Success to the results.

items.name: Follicle Control
items.description: Control over body hair growth, length and color (slow and messy).
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain to shed hair over the following minute, or 1 strain to stimulate hair growth (stubble ~4-5 hours, shaggy 12+ hours, shoulder length 1+ day, mid-back 2+ days). Can choose any natural hair color when growing.

items.name: Geno-Sculpted Physique
items.description: Cosmetic changes to eye color, muscle definition, facial features, and minor height/weight; grants no actual strength.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain before a Charm or Leadership check to add a Success to the results.

items.name: Nighteyes
items.description: Altered eyes give passive night vision but make the user sensitive to bright light.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain before a Vigilance or Perception check in dark conditions to add a Success to the results. In bright conditions, add a Success and a Threat to the results instead.

items.name: Tooth Buds
items.description: Canines regrow as long, sharp fangs; strengthened jaw. Hard to fully close the mouth (lisping, drooling).
items.effect: Unarmed Brawl attacks (biting) deal +2 damage and have Vicious 1. Add a boost die to all Coercion checks and a setback die to all Charm checks.

items.name: Toxin Filters
items.description: Harmless tumor-like growths filter toxins; cannot get drunk or high, generally impervious to atmospheric toxins.
items.effect: Suffer 1 strain before a Resilience check to resist poisons, toxins, or addiction to add a Success to the results. May suffer 1 strain to cancel the effects of a drug in your system (no effect on slap-patches).
